purpose: Replay the best memory-carrier compromises, neighboring root failures, duplicate formula settings, the best raw branch, and the local control with eight lens-geometry starts.
claim_boundary: Universal gravity constants are copied unchanged from the memory-carrier bridge fit.
No gravity constant, transport exponent, strength, scale, or channel is fitted to raw lensing.
Only pseudo-elliptical geometry, shear, center, and source positions are fitted to raw training images.
Candidates with missing held-out roots remain failures even when RMS over surviving roots is small.
The replay was selected after viewing two-start results and is a numerical robustness test, not an independent holdout.
Duplicate structural settings with different bridge seeds are retained as a fit-repeatability diagnostic.
